title: The Robot
lines: Ben has a little robot. It can hum.
It can make music and open a box.
Ben tells it to open the red box.
The robot picks up a red tulip from it.
It gives the tulip to Mom, and she grins.
Then the robot stops. It is silent.
Ben taps it, but it will not hum.
He tips it up and finds gum in it.
Ben rubs at the gum, but it is stuck.
Mom picks the gum off with a pin.
The robot hums a tune and Ben claps.

questions.ask: What did the robot pick up?
questions.listenFor: A red tulip, which it gave to Mom. Stated in the story - send them back to the line.

questions.ask: Why did the robot go silent?
questions.listenFor: A bit of gum was stuck in it. Ben found it when he tipped the robot up.

questions.ask: What do you think Ben should tell the robot to do next? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Anything goes here. You are listening for an idea plus a reason - that reason is the part worth praising.
